01 / FROM ACTION TO ACCOUNT

A clear record of
consequential work.

Refunds, deliveries, database writes. When agents change something, a successful response is only one piece of the record.

01

Capture the action.

Declare the intended outcome, then retain dispatches, responses and the agent’s reported assessment in a typed trace.

HISTORY
02

Read back independently.

Your application supplies a verifier and a trusted read-only source. State, timing, persistence and origin remain explicit.

EVIDENCE
03

Inspect the explanation.

ACCOUNT
↳

You define what counts as success. Consequa-X preserves and explains the supplied evidence; it does not authenticate a source or turn a graph edge into proof of causal necessity.

03 / BUILT FOR THE INVESTIGATION

Keep the context.
Respect the boundaries.

E01
Readback 01Readback 02

Every witness stays visible.

Successive observations of the same effect keep separate witnesses. A later status or payload cannot silently overwrite an earlier record.

LOCAL ALIASES

Share a smaller surface.

Default reports omit captured payloads and raw identifiers, using local display aliases. Revealing captured fields is an explicit choice.

</>
trace.json → report.html

One file. No dashboard setup.

Inspect a self-contained report in your browser, without a model, API key, hosted account or web server. Keep the original trace as the evidence record.

Field omission reduces disclosure; it is not universal PII detection. Source trust and contract semantics remain the application’s responsibility.

04 / FIRST EVIDENCE IN MINUTES

Start with a trace.
Make it inspectable.

Install the Python package, generate synthetic examples, and open an offline report. Nothing in this quickstart performs a real delivery or refund.

Follow the five-minute guide ↗

Version 1.1 is being prepared. The stable 1.0 package is available on PyPI; the report command below belongs to 1.1.

YOUR TERMINALPython 3.11+
$ python -m pip install consequa-x==1.1.0
# Generate captured synthetic examples$ consequa-x demo --output my-demo# Export a self-contained report with reduced disclosure$ consequa-x report \
  my-demo/traces/episode_01.json \
  --output my-report.html# Open my-report.html in your browser.
No model. No credentials. No external calls.
